heroHeadline: Georgian Dream Power Broker Mdinaradze Quits Politics Days After Garibashvili's Ivanishvili Break
heroSubtitle: Minister and longtime Georgian Dream heavyweight Mamuka Mdinaradze abruptly resigned and quit politics entirely three days after jailed ex-PM Irakli Garibashvili's public break with founder Bidzina Ivanishvili, as Garibashvili himself announced he would boycott all further hearings on his new bribery case, calling it a 'political masquerade'; President Kavelashvili pardoned 226 prisoners for the Mariamoba holiday including nine protest-related detainees, Germany's new ambassador took up her post amid ties 'marked by tensions,' and Tbilisi protests reached their 638th consecutive day with a 69-year-old demonstrator jailed 15 days.
